'''Sri'quay'va''' was one of the [[Deity/Legends|deities]] of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] religion. He was described as "the Father," and upset the balance in the heavens by creating a number of worshippers. When [[Sri'quay]], "the Mother," created her own children, Sri'quay'va because jealous, and created his own child, [[Quay'va]], who had power over fire.<ref name="LoNH" />
